goal: Let external mining clients see how much memory their open block templates hold in the node
Prevent transactions evicted from the mempool from remaining pinned indefinitely without visibility
agreement: Strong support with all major objections resolved (ryanofsky, vasild, xyzconstant, enochaz)
Concept approved for tracking template memory and hardening mining interfaces (ryanofsky)
Tested with a Stratum v2 template provider on mainnet for 20 hours (xyzconstant)
Minor suggestions on template unregistration interface remain optional to address (ryanofsky)

categories.name: ipc
why: P2 because it lets IPC clients inspect template memory load and prune stale templates across the boundary
It also hardens node shutdown against asynchronous IPC cleanup races

categories.name: mining
why: P2 because it exposes memory pinned by stale block templates containing transactions evicted from mempool
It provides resource accounting needed by external miners such as Stratum v2 template providers
